intro: In the 4 official DSSSB TGT Computer Science papers of 2023–24 there were {n} Networks questions, about 11 per paper — the second-heaviest CS area. DSSSB follows Forouzan and Tanenbaum chapter by chapter, well beyond the syllabus line: layers and devices, signals and media, error control and multiple access, subnetting numericals, TCP congestion control, port numbers, cryptography algorithms, and GSM / Mobile IP terms. Start with the fast-revision sheet, then read the chapters you are weakest in.
